metadata.description: Net worth records and checks kept on your own machine

plugins.name: finwright
plugins.description: Your own net worth records and checks, kept on your machine: bank, card, 401k, IRA, brokerage, savings bond (I and EE, valued from Treasury's value files), home and loan balances, with every number computed by a standard-library Python CLI in decimal arithmetic. QFX/OFX and bank CSV imports, allocation drift, 401k fund fees and their cost over 30 years, money-weighted and time-weighted returns, a percent-only view for sharing, contribution limits, SCF benchmarks, statement redaction, and a researched map of the finance apps, MCP servers and data routes. Read-only: never logs in, never moves money, not financial advice. Evergreen.
